hypothesis_title: DPL_KR_v2 Sorted Portfolio Learning — 5축 paradigm 리디자인으로 SR 2.0 돌파 검증
hypothesis_description: v1 (WT-D20260517_001) 실패 원인 5건 (EW collapse / TO violation / MDD breach / over-parameterized / loss instability)을 학술 문헌 deep review (Zhang-Wu-Chen 2021 China SR 2.0 / Zhong et al. 2024 DSPO / Wood-Roberts-Zohren 2026 DeePM / Uysal-Li-Mulvey 2021 End-to-End Risk Budgeting / Wang-Hasuike 2026 SPO inflation) 통해 5축 paradigm 리디자인. v2 핵심 변경: (1) Output = weights 직접 → **sorted portfolio ranked list → top-K** (DSPO Zhong 2024, EW collapse 본질 회피), (2) Architecture = Transformer 165K → **Set-Sequence permutation-invariant 30K params** (Epstein-Sadhwani-Giesecke 2025), (3) Loss = -E[r] → **Listwise Plackett-Luce + EVaR worst-window robust + Turnover-Adjusted IR 합성** (Zhang 2021 + Wood 2026 + Wang-Hasuike 2026), (4) Turnover control = γ=1.0 weak → **decision-induced ranking clipping + min-max rescaling + partial portfolio adjustment** (Wang-Hasuike 2026 SPO inflation mitigation), (5) Regime robustness = single model → **DeePM worst-window EVaR + Macro Graph Prior + m4 regime inherit** (Wood 2026). 핵심 학술 근거: Zhang-Wu-Chen 2021 China A-share market 68 factors 2006-2019 → annual 38% / **SR 2.0** (KR과 가장 유사 emerging market 실증). 도훈 mandate '실험설계를 다시 바꿔서 해보자' + '이게 SR 2.0 돌파의 답' decisive confidence 정합.
